source_binding: Both complete storage and private-file race suites, package lint, policy, and platform compilation bind the three committed Go files. The source prose check binds the store contract. The remaining implementation comes from the unchanged base commit.
limits: A direct probe reproduced raw filesystem absence from AcquireGeneration and failure when Collect saw an existing empty root. The probe command exited successfully because it reports observations. Its JSON output proves both defects, and its exact Go source remains archived.

The regression matrix records four failing subcases and their failing parent, plus two passing subcases. It covers missing acquisition, absent collection, empty collection, an empty generations directory, missing requirements, and a stale expected head.

Missing generation acquisition and missing required IDs now return the catalog not-found error. A nonempty expected head conflicts with an absent root. Empty filesystem stores permit a successful collection with zero usage.

The complete storage and private-file suites pass 257 test events on each Go toolchain. These runs repeat the same cases and include parents. They have no failures or skips and do not supply 514 distinct cases.
Package lint, goago, and source prose pass. Linux and Windows test binaries compile. Native platform execution remains unverified for this retention implementation.

The earlier filesystem-retention proof remains bound to 199cdaaf. This follow-up fixes its empty-store boundary without changing the retirement format, lease protocol, or existing publisher synchronization.

Object storage, runtime adoption, observation-file collection, distinct-inventory retirement, twelve mapped subcases, full verification, review, native CI, and merge remain open. CSP5 remains unpublished until its complete contract passes.
Five concurrent tooling edits remain outside this commit. Final task qualification must use the committed module graph.
The final canonical prose check passes. Source snapshots separate the concurrent tooling edits from six owned documentation files. Task criteria, scope, invariants, and the goal remain unchanged.
